tenderSchedule.description: Providing lunch to powrakarmikas and drivers of TMC Moodubidire for the year 2026-27

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Lunch must be supplied at Ground near Moodubidire Taluk office and SWM site located at Sy. No. 113/1 of Karinje Village, Moodubidire TMC by 12.00pm each day by the tenderer
Tenderer must quote the rate of food per plate per person while quoting the tender rates
Tenderer should adhere to all the conditions in this tender document
TMC MOODUBDIRE reserves the right to select/reject any tenderer or cancel the tender process

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Bank Account Passbook front page, GST Certificate copies
Certified Copy of Annual Turnover Certificate of Rs.7.00 lakhs
Copy of similar experience of supply of food to any type of customers within the past three years
Hotel Trade/Food Catering Service Trade License
